name: Eye of the Storm
description: At the start of each of this unit's turns, %count% random enemy within %range% tile is struck by lightning for %damage% damage.
details: A struck enemy is left with a permanent, stacking vulnerability adding %bonus_damage% damage to everything that hits it afterwards.
A unit held by Static Link is always struck as well.
A unit cannot be struck more than once per turn.

upgrade.summary: %count% bolts fall each turn, and vulnerability rises to %bonus_damage%.
upgrade.description: At the start of each of this unit's turns, %count% random enemies within %range% tile are struck by lightning for %damage% damage each.
details: A struck enemy is left with a permanent, stacking vulnerability adding %bonus_damage% damage to everything that hits it afterwards.
Stacks already on the board keep the value they were laid down at - only new ones are worth %bonus_damage%.
A unit held by Static Link is always struck as well.
A unit cannot be struck more than once per turn, so %count% bolts need %count% separate enemies.
